newsitem.title: USA: Viking Capital to buy NIAI Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Viking Capital to buy NIAI Insurance.

text.p: Viking Capital Group Inc said Tuesday that it and NIAI Insurance Administrators Inc signed a letter of intent for the acquisition of NIAI by Viking.
Viking issued a news release calling the move "another step towards the goal of securing $1.5 billion in insurance managed assets and generating outside fee income."
The sale, scheduled to close during the first week of August, will be transacted through a tax-free exchange of stock, the release said.
